timeout.description: Thunder API did not respond within 10s

server_error.description: Thunder API returned 500 Internal Server Error

bad_slug.description: Invalid library slug returns 200 with empty results (no explicit error)

rate_limited.description: Thunder API returned 429 Too Many Requests

not_found.description: Unknown library slug returns an explicit HTTP 404 (FR-A2)

availability_400.description: HIGH-3/HIGH-5: bulk-availability endpoint returns 400 (probe-triggering) — ambiguous between a bad title ID and a bad slug; disambiguated by GET /v2/libraries/{slug}.

availability_429.description: HIGH-5: 429 on availability is a non-probed top-level error.

availability_401.description: HIGH-5: 401 on availability is a non-probed top-level error.

availability_403.description: HIGH-5: 403 on availability is a non-probed top-level error.

availability_408.description: HIGH-5: 408 on availability is a non-probed top-level error.

library_probe_4xx.description: HIGH-3: GET /v2/libraries/{slug} returns a 4xx — confirms the slug itself is bad (bad-slug probe branch).

library_probe_ok.description: HIGH-3: GET /v2/libraries/{slug} returns a valid LibraryResponse — the slug is fine, so a 400/404 on availability means the title(s) were rejected (slug-OK branch).
